creator.description:
Labels AI Media across AtProto.

Consider following our main account @blackwall.gg and/or liking the labeler

reporting with proof/reasoning helps, but is not required. 

The DMs of this account are open for inquiries regarding reports

locales.description: When set to warn OR hide, blurs AI profile pictures and displays a badge under their profile
locales.name: AI Banner/PFP

locales.description: Unlike the first one, this ONLY shows a badge without blurring profile pictures, if you do not set the above one to off you will see two badges.
locales.name: AI Banner/PFP (badge)

locales.description: Accounts that are known to post works that indirectly use AI imagery, such as tracing over them. or via reference.
locales.name: Indirect AI Imagery Poster

locales.description: Unlike the first one, this ONLY shows a badge without warning or hiding the content, if you do not set the above one to off you will see two badges.
locales.name: Indirect AI Imagery Poster (badge)
